production source routing includes the gold source type
retrieval_probes: unrestricted vector top 50 at the production similarity threshold
unrestricted vector top 200 with threshold zero
method.classification: mutually exclusive in the bucket order stored below

next_single_hypothesis: Production lexical retrieval truncates the candidate space before enough document-diverse lexical evidence can reach fusion. Fetching a bounded deeper OR-lexical pool, diversifying by canonical URL, and only then truncating back to the existing fusion budget will recover relevant URLs without increasing final answer-time top_k.

experiment.change: Fetch up to 200 OR-lexical chunks, cap one chunk per canonical URL, then preserve the existing 15-candidate fusion budget.
experiment.conclusion: A deeper document-diverse OR-lexical pool alone did not recover any additional gold URL, so the production change was reverted and the 57% baseline remains current.

limitations: The diagnosis identifies the largest observed boundary; it does not claim causal attribution between the prior calendar and diversification changes.
Individual PostgreSQL FTS ranks can move among equal-score chunks, so the stable signal is bucket membership within the observed top-200 window rather than an exact tied rank.
